title: LVLM-Aided Alignment of Task-Specific Vision Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating Worst Group Accuracy (WGA) and Average Group Accuracy (AGA) on datasets containing visual shortcuts (e.g., artificial decoy patches in MNIST, colored bandages in skin lesion images, and hospital tags in knee radiographs) to measure the model's reliance on irrelevant artifactual features rather than core task features.
